entries.source:
#DARK_SEA_GREEN##{italic}#Fresh air!#{normal}##LAST#
Nice job! You handled yourself a lot better than I thought you would. Now, usually I get a reward... What? Why are you looking at me like that? I'm obviously the one who saved you here. It's customary for adventurers to get rewarded when they do a good deed.
entries.target:
#DARK_SEA_GREEN##{italic}#新鲜的空气！#{normal}##LAST#
干得好！你做得比我想象中好多了。接下来，按惯例我该得到奖励了…唔？你为什么这么看着我？很显然，我救了你。冒险者做好事的时候通常会得到奖励。

entries.source: Oh this will sure come in handy! Thanks!
entries.target: 哦，这个技能很有用！谢谢！

entries.source: I always did want to learn how to do these kind of things!
entries.target: 我一直都想学会怎么做这种事！

entries.source: Oh, I suddenly feel like I have potential to grow.
entries.target: 哦，我觉得我的潜能增长了。

entries.source: ...Fine, be that way. Good luck out there, though.
entries.target: …好吧，就这样吧。祝你一路顺风。

entries.source: #DARK_SEA_GREEN##{italic}#As you move you suddenly find yourself entrapped in a hidden digestive sack that seems to void all your abilities!#{normal}##LAST#
entries.target: #DARK_SEA_GREEN##{italic}#在你向前移动的时候，你突然发现自己掉进了一个隐藏的消化袋里，它似乎让你所有的能力都失效了！#{normal}##LAST#

entries.source:
#DARK_SEA_GREEN##{italic}#As were starting to lose hope you hear some kind of cutting.#{normal}##LAST#
There's someone else in here?
entries.target:
#DARK_SEA_GREEN##{italic}#在你快要放弃希望的时候，你听到了切开东西的声音。#{normal}##LAST#
有人在里面吗？

entries.source:
#DARK_SEA_GREEN##{italic}#As the sack gets cut and you regain your mobility you see your savior is some kind of adventurer, she was probably eaten by the Godfeaster too.#{normal}##LAST#
This thing ate you too? Hey, at least you've got company. Name's Malyu, I've been stuck in here for a few days now and had to tough it out alone. I was about to go for this thing's brain when you showed up. What say we team up and get out of here together?
entries.target:
#DARK_SEA_GREEN##{italic}#袋子被割开后，你恢复了行动能力。你发现救你的人是一个冒险家，她好像也被噬神者吞下了。#{normal}##LAST#
这个东西也吃了你？嘿，至少你有一个伴了。我的名字是马虑，我已经被困在这里好几天，不得不独自面对这一切。我本来准备破坏这个东西的大脑，结果遇到了你。我们一起离开这个地方怎么样？

entries.source: I am glad for the help, you saved me. Let's kill this thing and get out!
entries.target: 感谢你的帮助，你救了我。我们一起杀了这个怪物，逃出去吧！

entries.source:
#YELLOW_GREEN##{bold}#Suddenly the strange metallic device emits some beeps and starts to speak. Somehow.#{normal}##LAST#
Uplink established with remote satellite. Activating emergency communication array.
Current user does not match with previous user records. Performing scan.
entries.target:
#YELLOW_GREEN##{bold}#突然，这台奇怪的金属装置发出了哔哔声，然后开始说话了。不知怎么地。#{normal}##LAST#
与卫星建立上行链接。启动紧急通信阵列。
当前用户和之前的用户记录不匹配。正在扫描。

entries.source:
#YELLOW_GREEN##{bold}#The device beeps again and speaks.#{normal}##LAST#
User's biological signature matches expected species, but does not match any identity records in database. Sending information for further analysis.

User added to database. I am now your personal assistant and will help you survive until further assistance can arrive. Enabling protective electromagnetic barrier and real time health monitoring.
entries.target:
#YELLOW_GREEN##{bold}#这个机器哔哔了几下，又说了起来。#{normal}##LAST#
用户的生理学特征符合预期物种，但在数据库中没有记录。正在发送信息以供进一步分析。

用户已添加到数据库。我现在是你的私人助理，在后续救援到来之前，我会帮助你活下去。已启动保护性电磁屏障和实时健康监测程序。

entries.source:
#YELLOW_GREEN##{bold}#The device beeps again and speaks.#{normal}##LAST#
User's biological signature indicates dangerous degeneration of genome due to unknown factors. Sending information for further analysis.
entries.target:
#YELLOW_GREEN##{bold}#这个机器哔哔了几下，又说了起来。#{normal}##LAST#
由于不明原因，用户的生理特征表现出危险的基因劣化。正在发送信息以供进一步分析。

entries.source:
#YELLOW_GREEN##{bold}#The device beeps again and speaks.#{normal}##LAST#
No signs of life detected. User appears to be still moving despite absence of living tissue. Sending information for further analysis.
entries.target:
#YELLOW_GREEN##{bold}#这个机器哔哔了几下，又说了起来。#{normal}##LAST#
没有检测到生命信号。目标看上去在活动，但没有活着的生物组织。正在发送信息以供进一步分析。

entries.source: Never seen an undead have you?

#YELLOW_GREEN##{bold}#The device beeps again and speaks.#{normal}##LAST#
User's biological signature does not match any currently known species in database. Sending information for further analysis.

entries.source: #YELLOW_GREEN##{bold}#The machine beeps twice, then goes completely silent. Any further attempts to get it to speak prove futile.#{normal}##LAST#
entries.target: #YELLOW_GREEN##{bold}#机器发出两下哔哔声，然后完全安静了下来。你再也没法让它再次说话了。#{normal}##LAST#

entries.source:
The ground suddenly shakes under your feet and a giant worm appears to gobble you up!
You could try to escape using the Rod of Recall or accept your fate.
entries.target:
你脚下的大地在颤动，一只巨大的蠕虫突然出现，将你吞了进去！
你可以尝试使用回归之杖来逃离，或者接受你的命运。

entries.source: You manage in extremis to activate the rod in emergency. As you keep on falling towards the maw of the worm the rod finishes charging up and you re-appear nearby, safe from the monstrosity.
entries.target: 你在千钧一发之际启动了回归之杖。当你不断坠向虫子的巨口时，回归之杖充能完毕，你在附近重新出现，脱离了那怪物的威胁。

entries.source: #DARK_SEA_GREEN#It was corrupted by the digestive sack.
#DARK_SEA_GREEN#It was hardened by the digestive sack.
#DARK_SEA_GREEN#It was changed by the digestive sack.

entries.target: #DARK_SEA_GREEN#一个物品从消化袋里掉了出来！

entries.source: #DARK_SEA_GREEN#A not yet digested foe burst out from the sack!
entries.target: #DARK_SEA_GREEN#一个没有被完全消化的敌人从消化袋里掉了出来！

entries.source: #DARK_SEA_GREEN#Sickening fumes emanates from the sack as it opens!
entries.target: #DARK_SEA_GREEN#袋子打开时散发出令人作呕的烟雾！
空气里充斥着瘟疫的味道

entries.source: You smell a blighted perfume in the air for an instant...
entries.target: 你瞬间闻到了枯萎的味道……

entries.source: You have already scavenged what you could understand and use.
entries.target: 你已经找遍了你能理解和使用的东西。

entries.source:
The thing in front of you appears to be a strange dome made from green glass. Judging by the crater around it, this dome must have crashed into the earth with tremendous force. Stranger still is the figure seated inside it. It appears to be wearing a suit made of an unknown material and a glass dome over its head. Looking inside the dome, you can plainly see that the figure is a dwarf! There is no mistaking that oversized nose. Judging by the smell, he has been dead for quite some time.

You are fairly sure that the dwarves aren't capable of making something like this and they definitely don't dress like that. So, where did this odd dwarf come from? Taking a closer look, you find a strange device attached to the dwarf's arm. You remove it with no small amount of effort. It is completely unlike anything you have seen before and you're not really sure what to make of it. Perhaps if you hold onto it, you might be able to discern its functionality later.
entries.target:
出现在你眼前的是一个被绿色玻璃遮罩的太空舱，根据附近的弹坑判断，这个太空舱曾以极快的速度撞击地面，里面仍坐着一个奇怪的生物，穿着不明材质的衣服，戴着绿色玻璃做成的头罩。透过绿色的玻璃看去，能看到矮人标志性的大鼻子，你清楚地发现这是一个矮人！从气味判断，他已经死了很久了。

你很肯定矮人不会做出这样的东西，而且他们绝对不会穿那样的衣服。那么，这个奇怪的矮人是从哪里来的？仔细观察，你会发现一个奇怪的装置附在矮人的手臂上。你费了不小的力气才把它取下来。它和你见过的任何东西都不一样，你也不知道该怎么做。如果你留下它，也许你以后可以辨别出它的功能。
